newsitem.title: USA: Allstar Systems IPO target price cut.
newsitem.headline: Allstar Systems IPO target price cut.

text.p: Terms were modified for the planned initial public offering in Allstar Systems Inc, calling for a lower target price and number of shares, lead underwriter Sutro & Co said on Tuesday.

A target price of $6 has been proposed. Previously, an estimated price range of $7 to $8 per share was proposed, lower than the original estimated price range of $8 to $10. The proposed number of shares was lowered to 1,767,500 from 2.035 million shares previously.

Allstar Systems, which provides computer and telecommunications hardware and software, is expected to trade next Monday under the symbol ALLS.O on the Nasdaq National Market. The Houston company postponed an earlier plan to go public with underwriter Rauscher Pierce Refnes.
